administrative_preservation_checks_at_pu.preservation_scope_limit: No claim to monitor other Codex worktree files, index, locks, jobs or unpublished results. Preservation uses fixed base blobs, scoped parent/prior-own state and write allowlist.
administrative_preservation_checks_at_pu.scope: Administrative bytes/SHA/Git/JSON/AST-location/document checks only, not a scientific test or mathematical/numeric/native/novelty certification.

receipt_policy: Receipt is committed in a metadata-only direct child. Final remote HEAD and every final changed file including this receipt are verified separately, avoiding self-hash recursion. No other-worktree state or Codex A private work is inspected.
scope: Static interface/acceptance audit; not end-to-end scientific/numeric/native verification, implementation or scientific review. NPZ is opaque byte identity only, never decoded.
